facts.fact: 圣诞前两天：父母飞来LA看她比赛也看Carson的
facts.anchor: It was two days until Christmas, and Mom and Dad had flown in earlier in the week

facts.fact: Levi意外现身——与Alan十指相扣走进包厢
facts.anchor: asked a familiar voice, and I jolted.

facts.fact: 他主动要求单独谈：这一切是他自己策划的圣诞惊喜
facts.anchor: Is there somewhere more private we can talk?

facts.fact: 他的道歉：抱歉这几个月把你关在门外
facts.anchor: I’m sorry for shutting you out these past few months.

facts.fact: 他开始做治疗：离婚+被背叛的未解创伤叠加
他的柔软：没有你的日子太安静了
facts.anchor: Life has felt…really quiet without you.

facts.fact: 她的新约：不再用隐瞒来保护彼此——那只会削弱关系
她穿Carson球衣看球被调侃：爱让人做疯狂事
facts.anchor: Love makes us do crazy things.

facts.fact: 和解核心：即使对象是Carson，也祝你幸福
章节重磅：我想让我们重新成为一家人
facts.anchor: I want us to be a family again.

facts.fact: 他提议一起过圣诞——全家
facts.anchor: I was really hoping we could spend them all together.

facts.fact: 纹身升级：空白罗盘加了指向8号的箭头——他的true north是Logan
facts.anchor: The compass used to be blank, but I’d had the tattoo artist add a face. The arrow was pointing to a number 8

facts.fact: 他的告白终章：你是我的家人，我的真北
facts.anchor: You are my family. My true north.

facts.fact: 圣诞礼物：触觉手环——震动传情（I love you / I miss you / Are you okay）
facts.anchor: That’s because it’s a haptic bracelet.

facts.fact: 他终于要公开穿她的名字——不藏了
facts.anchor: I want to post it on my socials.

facts.fact: Levi对Carson：才华我早知道，但其余的一切让我尊重他
facts.anchor: I’d admire the hell out of him.

facts.fact: 妈妈收编：欢迎来到这个家
